title: Invertibility of plus-derived base change under right acyclicity
statement: For abelian categories B B' C C' with derived categories and enough injectives, additive functors G : B ⥤ C, G' : B' ⥤ C', β : B ⥤ B', γ : C ⥤ C' preserving finite limits and colimits, and e : G ⋙ γ ≅ β ⋙ G', if G' preserves finite limits and β sends every injective I to a G'-right-acyclic object, then IsIso (Functor.rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange e.hom).
